row.notes: Iterates candidate driver keys (param_4+8..+0x10, u32) and writes the first for which 0x140d94f10(comp, driver, *team) is true to *param_2; if none writes 0x3fff0000 and logs CONTRACT_RENEWAL 'No valid driver found to approach'. Returns param_2. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Career_ContractRenewal_FindFirstApproachableDriver (bound record keeps its name).
